# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

This repository is an open-source demonstration project and does not provide a commercial support SLA.

## Where to ask

- Use the bug report issue form for reproducible defects in this repository.
- Use the feature request form for scoped improvements.
- Use the question form for setup or usage questions when GitHub Discussions is not available.
- Use the security reporting process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities; do not file them publicly.

## Before requesting help

Please include the relevant commit SHA, Python version, execution environment, accelerator topology when applicable, command or endpoint used, and a minimal log excerpt with secrets removed.

For Kaggle GPU issues, state whether the session is T4 x2 and whether the failure occurred before or after the runtime/device preflight. Do not assume that a CPU-only reproduction proves the T4 x2 runtime path.
